name: To Fall In Love With A Vending Machine
source:
Ernest thinks he's going to have yet another boring day in his work life until he encounters a very nice sentient vending machine that wins him over.

[from [url=https://axxisproductions.itch.io/to-fall-in-love-with-a-vending-machine]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欧内斯特认为他的工作生活又将度过无聊的一天，直到他遇到了一台非常好的有感知能力的自动售货机，赢得了他的青睐。

[来自[url=https://axxisproductions.itch.io/to-fall-in-love-with-a-vending-machine]itch.io[/url]]
